Company Information

 

 

Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co.,Ltd 

       Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer of terminals and connectors integrating R&D, production, and sales, with a high-quality management team and technical elites. The company has established a series of core departments, such as R&D center, mold workshop, automatic tapping, and automatic assembly workshop. The R&D center is equipped with advanced CIMS systems, and the mold workshop is equipped with hundreds of high-precision devices to maintain and enhance the craftsmanship of precision injection molding, stamping, die casting, and cutting.
